summary: Frontend verification-related pages and terminology updates appear to be implemented (admin review page, provider upload/status page, “Administrator Tools” wording). However, the diff summary does not provide clear evidence that the required backend verification/document endpoints (and their admin-only protections) were implemented, nor that React Query invalidations/refetching for the new verification flows were wired as required. Several unrelated UI/features were also modified/added beyond the verification workflow scope (e.g., landing page, support drawer, role onboarding changes, MPesa/bio-data hooks).

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement backend endpoints for provider document submission and admin-only verification review (list providers for review, fetch full provider profile including documents/status, verify/reject with reason), rejecting non-admin callers for admin methods.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo is truncated and the diff summary does not show any of the required new backend methods/endpoints or the admin-only access checks; only type additions are visible.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add React Query hooks and UI wiring for verification/document endpoints with query invalidation/refetch so status changes appear immediately (invalidate לפחות ['currentUserProfile'] and provider/admin review lists), and surface non-admin errors in a user-readable way.
missing_requirements.reason: Although the file summary claims verification hooks exist, the provided truncated diff content for frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts does not show the new verification queries/mutations nor any onSuccess invalidations for them (beyond currentUserProfile invalidation for saveCallerUserProfile).

hallucinated_features.description: Added a backend upgrade migration module even though the migration shown is a no-op (OldActor/NewActor are empty and run returns {}).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest constraint says to only generate backend/migration.mo if adding/changing stable state requiring an upgrade migration; the added migration appears unrelated/no-op based on the diff content.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/modified unrelated frontend features: landing page overhaul, support drawer contact info, header/footer changes, role onboarding/category selection changes, Tailwind/theme/style changes, and additional hooks (e.g., M-Pesa config, client bio data).
hallucinated_features.reason: These changes are not requested by REQ-1..REQ-5 (which are specific to provider verification workflow, related UI terminology, and React Query wiring for that workflow).

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced a polling interval state in ProviderResultsPage with an empty interval callback (commented “Trigger refetch by invalidating the query” but not implemented in the shown snippet).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not part of requested verification workflow requirements and appears incomplete/unused in the shown diff excerpt.
